title: Exploring chiral and achiral properties of novel multilayer 3D polymers: synthesis and characterization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3227-3236
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00233H, Paper
Open Access

Sai Zhang, Qingzheng Xu, Xiuyuan Qin, Yutin Wang, Jialing Mao, Yue Zhang, Guigen Li
This study reports the novel synthesis of multilayered 3D polymers via the 1,3,5-position coupling of 1,3,5-tris(4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-1,3,2-dioxaborolan-2-yl)benzene with 1,8-dibronaphthalene, a previously unreported method.
